description: This file implements a generic Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) processor with various size-specific and optimized algorithms, including templates for different sizes and SIMD optimizations. It defines classes for different radix-2, radix-3, radix-5, and mixed-size DFT computations, and a main implementation class that selects the appropriate algorithm based on input size.

classes.name: generic_dft_dit
classes.description: Template class implementing various sizes of decimation-in-time DFT algorithms, optimized for different size constraints and including specializations for small sizes like 3 and 4.

classes.name: dft_processor_generic_impl
classes.description: Main class that configures and runs the appropriate DFT algorithm based on input size and direction.

methods.name: dft_processor_generic_impl::run
methods.description: Executes the selected DFT algorithm on input data and returns the output as a span.
